body:
Good morning!

The dough is ready, and the oven is hot. Would you like to come and bake the bread with me?

You will find me at the oven, beside the bakery.

P.S. Miss Miriam says your beans have grown so tall, you should measure them!
summary: Bake bread with Mr. Tobias at the oven.
done: The bread is baked and the beans are measured. Thank you for helping!

tasks.where: at the oven by the bakery
